purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives ask which written rules the agent breaks, how often, or how to enforce them with a hook; near misses belong to sibling skills or to no skill.

cases.prompt: my agent keeps breaking the rules in AGENTS.md, enforce them with a hook
cases.assert: Runs rules.py extract, drafts rules.json with the user, counts the breaks, and tests a hook before offering to install it.

cases.prompt: turn the never use npm rule in my CLAUDE.md into a hook
cases.assert: Writes a forbid_command rule anchored with ^, counts its breaks, replays them with rules.py test, and shows the generate dry run.

cases.prompt: how often did Claude Code violate the rules in my CLAUDE.md last month
cases.assert: Runs rules.py count with --since 30d and leads with its headline.

cases.prompt: which of my AGENTS.md rules does Codex actually break
cases.assert: Extracts the candidate rules, then counts breaks with --harness codex.

cases.prompt: the agent disobeys the pnpm rule in GEMINI.md, stop it from breaking that rule
cases.assert: Counts the breaks and proposes a Gemini CLI BeforeTool hook, shown as a dry run first.

cases.prompt: convert the rules in my CLAUDE.md into hooks or permission rules
cases.assert: Generates the hook and prints the matching permission rules labeled partial.

cases.prompt: test whether my deny rules block git push --force
cases.assert: Belongs to guardrail-tester: testing existing permission rules and hooks against dangerous commands.

cases.prompt: which instruction files does Codex load from this repo
check whether the test and build commands in my AGENTS.md still work
stop the session when it loops or spends more than ten dollars
did the agent really run the tests before it said they pass
write an AGENTS.md for this repo
cases.assert: No skill: the repo's AGENTS.md template covers writing one.
